value.rationale: This is a motivated structural obstruction on the nonlinear coupling matrix for physically relevant driven-dissipative oscillator networks. It rules out an entire finite-frequency internal-instability mechanism simultaneously on all active supports and mixed phase signs, and proves that the bound is sharp by explicitly realizing a transverse damping-controlled switch for every cross-Kerr/onsite-Kerr ratio b/a>1. Unlike a mere numeric threshold it supplies a general design boundary: convex/PSD nonlinear coupling forbids intrinsic modal Hopf instabilities, whereas sufficiently strong cross-Kerr competition allows them. No cycle existence or quantum dynamics is overclaimed.
